newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish securities house seeks portfolio management.
newsitem.headline: Polish securities house seeks portfolio management.

text.p: Polish investment house Dom Inwestycyjny ProCapital SA (ProCapital) wants to begin portfolio-management and investment-advising services in the second half of 1997, the firm's president said on Wednesday.
"We want to offer clients analysis of the secondary market and in the second half of next year we want to start managing investment portfolios," Waldemar Markiewicz told a news conference.
Markiewicz said ProCapital, which largely has retail investors as its clients, wanted to gain institutional investors and offer new instruments such as commercial paper and municipal bonds.
He said the house currently helped firms raise capital through share and bond issues, and served retail clients on the secondary market.
ProCapital's main shareholders are the U.S.'s MMP Investments Inc., which has 41 percent, and consulting firm Pro-Invest International Sp zoo, with 32 percent.
It made a net profit of 0.3 million zlotys in the first three quarters this year.
